goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester spent all 8 steps in the lobby/locker room and never got past gearing up. Gear rack interactions (Axe and Extinguisher) returned 'held, not triggered' every time, and walking to the Mission Board failed with NoPath. No fire was fought, no one was rescued and no water was refilled, so the goal was not met. The probe reported no server errors.

bugs.title: Gear rack prompts never trigger when held in range
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3, 4 and 5: interact on GearRack1 (Grab Axe) and GearRack2 (Grab Extinguisher) at about 3.8-7.8 studs (range 9) always returned 'done=False held, not triggered'. A raw E hold of 0.5s at step 5 gave the same result. Backpack stayed empty and the HUD showed 'empty hands'. This blocks gearing up and the rest of the round.

bugs.title: Mission Board unreachable by pathfinding (NoPath)
bugs.evidence: Step 6: walk_to Lobby.MissionBoard stopped 23.2 studs away with 'no path: NoPath'. Step 7: walk to (-45,6,165) stopped 17 studs short with NoPath and a timeout. The Bell at step 8 was also reached via a straight line with NoPath. The lobby may be disconnected from the locker room by the navmesh, or blocked by geometry, so the mission cannot be started.

bugs.title: No visible way to start a mission or round from the lobby
bugs.evidence: By step 8 the player was at the Bell and Mission Board area (about 24 studs from the board) with no SquadId and no instance. No round or fire started and no mission-start feedback appeared. The playtester could not confirm the start flow works, so it is unclear whether a prompt is missing or the player simply could not reach it.
